answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 12903 Country: MW Title: Asalaam alaikum, Please let me know the meaning of the following names: for males: 1) Sadeem 2)Zaid (Why was he the only sahaabah mentioned in the Quran) 3)Ubaid Females: 1) Aakifah 2)Zuhaira 3)Husna Wassallaam Question: Asalaam alaikum, Please let me know the meaning of the following names: for males: 1) Sadeem 2)Zaid (Why was he the only sahaabah mentioned in the Quran) 3)Ubaid Females: 1) Aakifah 2)Zuhaira 3)Husna Wassallaam Answer ID: 12903 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 787/615=L/1430) Sadeem: one who remembers much Zaid: growth, abundance, a Sahabi who was only mentioned by name in Quran Ubaid: little slave Aakifah: a woman who sticks to something, or who stays at a place Zuhairah: shinning, radiant, beautiful Husna: very beautiful Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
